name: dma_wr
contract: linear block write; bursts min(words,16,4KB-boundary); little-endian assembly (source byte k -> lane k); wstrb full except command tail; one outstanding AW; one B per burst; done after B-count aligns
gold_ref: DDR-side: every strobed byte at address a == F(word(a))>>8*(a%8); per-command count + additive checksum mod 2^64 + written-once bijection walk (command-relative bitmap, overlap-safe)
